methodology: Strict verification_equivalence_key matching -- a control promotes to AUTO_VERIFIED ONLY if its raw_path pattern, conversion type, and field identity exactly match one of the 8 Phase 2D sentinel keys. Section/module/name similarity alone is explicitly NOT sufficient.

filter_scalar_direct.sentinel: filter1.cutoff plus filter1.enabled(visual ON) plus filter1.type(visual Low24 default)

matrix_core.sentinel: matrix route1 lfo0 to filter0.cutoff amount=42

arp_core.sentinel: arp.rate=0.6 maps to 1/32 tier; shape=played visually confirmed

uncertain_meaning_exclusions: Fields flagged by serum-mcp own docstrings as UNCERTAIN exact meaning, or TESTED with no measurable effect, are excluded from promotion regardless of section membership -- classified OBSERVATION_GAP instead.

out_of_scope_evidence.browser: serum-mcp scope is preset-file generation/editing only; browser UI category/favorites/expanded state has no corresponding PresetSpec field and no raw schema field in schema.py -- confirmed absent from all 26 runtime modules in MCP_RUNTIME_FINGERPRINT.json
out_of_scope_evidence.clip: Clip/scene/session state belongs to the DAW host (Ableton Live), not the Serum preset file; serum-mcp tool descriptions (generate_preset/edit_preset/describe_preset) only ever reference .SerumPreset file paths, never DAW session objects
out_of_scope_evidence.topmenu: Top menu bar (wavetable browser dialog, sample browser dialog, undo/redo, settings) is transient host-GUI chrome, not preset-encoded state -- absent from all serum-mcp runtime modules
